findings_addressed.oracle: provider.current_model_id property (reads self._loaded_model.model_id if self._loaded_model else None — a separate code path from the attribute itself), cross-checked against the known model ID constant _LIVE_MODEL_ID before unload and None after unload
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/local_transformers.py line 1611, change `self._loaded_model = None` to `pass` — this makes unload_model() a no-op for the model reference, causing `provider.current_model_id` to still return _LIVE_MODEL_ID after the call, failing the `assert provider.current_model_id is None` assertion

notes: Added a pre-unload assertion (current_model_id == _LIVE_MODEL_ID) to prove the model is resident before unload_model() runs, then a post-unload assertion (current_model_id is None) that exercises the public property as an independent oracle. Avoided accessing the private _loaded_model attribute directly to satisfy basedpyright reportPrivateUsage. The test now gates both the model-load path and the unload contract, not just the disconnect flag.
